statements.t: We are providing the following guidance for our fourth quarter 2026 and full year 2026:
• Q4 2026: We expect revenue to be between $249 million and $251 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 46% at the midpoint.

We expect non-GAAP income from operations to be between $81 million and $83 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 71% and non-GAAP operating margin of 33% at the midpoint, a ~470 bps increase over Q4 2025.
• Full Year 2026: We are raising our revenue guidance to be between $879 million and $881 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 50% at the midpoint.

We are raising our non-GAAP income from operations guidance to be between $266 million and $268 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 123% and non-GAAP operating margin of 30% at the midpoint, a ~1,000 bps increase over 2025.

Moreover, we have not reconciled our non-GAAP income from operations and non-GAAP operating margin guidance to GAAP income from operations and GAAP operating margin because we do not and are not able to provide guidance for GAAP income from operations due to the uncertainty and potential variability of stock-based compensation expense, employer payroll tax expense related to stock-based compensation, amortization…
Because such items cannot be provided without unreasonable efforts, we are unable to provide a reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measure guidance to the corresponding GAAP measures.
We will host a conference call and webcast for investors on November 2, 2026 at 1:30 p.m.
Eastern Time) to discuss our financial results, business highlights and financial outlook.
We anticipate that this seasonality will continue and therefore focus on LTM calculated billings.
For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 we used a forecasted annual tax rate o f 24% an d for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 we used an annual tax rate of 20%.

We will periodically re-evaluate this tax rate, as necessary, for significant events, relevant tax law changes, material changes in the forecasted geographic earnings mix, and any significant transactions.
